sources.summary: Architecture studio MAD has revealed updated designs for the Danshuis dance centre in Rotterdam, the Netherlands, which will feature a billowing glass extension to an art deco warehouse. Situated in Rotterdam's docklands area, MAD announced plans to transform the existing Provimi warehouse in 2023.
